notes: Peak RSS includes the entire process. For WASI it includes Wasmtime compilation/runtime, not guest allocations alone.
Events are generated and projected in one streaming pass; event construction and dispatch are inside the projection timer.
Capacity is the largest tested point within the time budget, not a language or hardware maximum.
captureNotes: Captured on this repository checkout before final runner metadata/lifecycle summary additions. Raw per-sample lifecycle timings are retained.
Native-scaling used Apple Swift 6.4; WASI-scaling used official Swift 6.3.1 on both engines. Rust projection uses rustup stable 1.93.0, Go 1.23.4, .NET 11 RC3, Java 21.0.6 and Node 24.18.0.
C# native-scaling used STJ for excluded result reporting; WASI-scaling uses numeric JSON output. Projection update code is unchanged.
